certificate.title: Speed Up Claude Cowork 4x with Voice Dictation Completion

course.description: A 7-step guide to using Wispr Flow voice dictation with Claude Cowork to get richer outputs in less time. Learn why typing slows your AI sessions and how talking your prompts — messy, unfiltered, and long — delivers far better context than carefully crafted typed text. Based on a practical workflow by Claude power user Ruben Hassid.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in Speed Up Claude Cowork 4x with Voice Dictation.

modules.description: Install Wispr Flow and configure it to work seamlessly with Claude Cowork so you can dictate instead of type.

lessons.content: This is the hardest and most important step. Resist the urge to type your prompt. The act of typing causes you to self-edit, delete, and rephrase — killing context before Claude ever sees it. Commit to talking instead.
lessons.title: Stop Typing

lessons.content: Open your browser and navigate to **wispr.ai**. This is the home of Wispr Flow, the voice dictation tool you will use to talk directly into any text field — including Claude Cowork.
lessons.title: Go to wispr.ai

lessons.content: Download and install Wispr Flow. It is **free**. No integrations, no config, no heavy setup required. It works at the OS level so it works anywhere you can type text.
lessons.title: Download Wispr Flow

lessons.content: Open Wispr Flow settings and choose a keyboard shortcut to activate voice recording. Ruben Hassid recommends **Shift**. Pick something comfortable that you can hold down easily with one hand.
lessons.title: Pick Your Key Shortcut

lessons.content: Open Claude Cowork (or any Claude conversation). Hold down your shortcut key and start talking. Speak naturally — give Claude full context, background, and detail. Do not self-censor. Your voice dumps raw thinking that typed prompts filter out.
lessons.title: Open Claude and Talk

lessons.content: Release the key. Your spoken words appear in the Claude chat box automatically. Review quickly and hit send. The whole process takes seconds instead of minutes.
lessons.title: Release to Transcribe

lessons.content:
Visit **claude-co.work** for a free guide optimizing Cowork sessions with voice input.

**Pro tip on spoken feedback:** Instead of typing "make it less formal", say: *"The tone is too stiff. I want it to sound like I am texting a friend who runs a 200-person company. Keep the data but make it casual. Only redo section 2."* Your voice gives Claude the context to do the right thing.
lessons.title: Use the Free Setup Guide
